{{Quote|These are the ''new models'' we hoped you'd build!|[[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]], to [[Quingarus]]|<ref name="Foreclosure" />}}
This '''battle droid''' was an advanced type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|I've fought ''battle droids'' before, but the ''armour plating'' on these has been upgraded to an ''exceptional level''...|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Foreclosure" />}}
[[File:Unidentified_battle_droid_Foreclosure_1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The battle droids in their shells]]
This model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] resembled a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] with [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]. It was armed with a single [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and had an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating which was upgraded to an exceptional level.<ref name="Foreclosure" />

When not in attack mode, the battle droid was encased in a gray shell that made it seem to be unarmed. When called to action, the shell opened to release the battle droid and quickly disintegrated.<ref name="Foreclosure" />

==History==
{{Quote|Oh, thank you, thank you so much. They would have ''killed'' poor ol' Quingarus if you hadn't arrived.|[[Quingarus]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Foreclosure" />}}
[[File:Unidentified_battle_droid_Foreclosure_2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The battle droids leaving their shells]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], four of these [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] escorted [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] and another [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]] [[Unidentified Banking Clan representative|representative]] to the [[Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factory located on a [[Unidentified planet (Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory)|planet]] close to the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]]. There, the two Banking Clan members threatened the factory master [[Quingarus]], who had taken out a loan from the Banking Clan, to repay his debt by building this new type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]], at the rate of forty thousand units a [[Standard week/Legends|week]].<ref name="Foreclosure" />

However, Quingarus refused to switch his production lines to suit their demands, complaining that his family would starve as a consequence. Hill subsequently activated the four battle droids to kill Quingarus, but the [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] was [[Skirmish at the Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory|saved]] by the timely arrival of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had landed in the factory to get [[R4-P17/Legends|his]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] repaired. Kenobi destroyed three of these battles droids with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|his]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and another with the [[Telekinesis/Legends|use]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Foreclosure" />

Following the hasty departure of the two [[Banker/Legends|bankers]], Kenobi convinced Quingarus to accept [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] aid by making an agreement to have all the Republic's astromechs maintained at his factory, thus helping him pay back his loan easily and preventing the potential production of millions of war droids.<ref name="Foreclosure" />
